<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm) are at 22.80, 21.35, and 19.20 ppm, indicating three distinct methyl carbons. The peaks at 34.53 ppm are likely non‑methyl (e.g., CH₂) and thus not counted. Therefore, the molecule contains three CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
